ads.headline: Data Engineer inom Microsoft Fabric och Data & AI
ads.description_text:
Vår kund bygger framtidens dataplattformar. Här får du arbeta med den absolut senaste tekniken i Microsoft Fabric och driva innovativa projekt tillsammans med ett högkompetent team.
Om tjänsten
Som Data Engineer fokuserar du på att skapa värde genom moderna dataarkitekturer i Microsoft Fabric. Du arbetar i avancerade miljöer nära både kunder och specialister för att bygga robusta lösningar som möjliggör datadrivna beslut. Tillsammans med BI-utvecklare och arkitekter formar du framtidens dataplattformar.
Du erbjuds en plats i ett högkompetent team där du arbetar med den senaste tekniken och spännande kunduppdrag. Du får stora möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning samt chansen att påverka tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt i en miljö där egna initiativ uppmuntras.
Arbetsuppgifter
Rollen innebär tekniskt ansvar för att bygga och underhålla moderna dataplattformar med fokus på Microsofts ekosystem, från rådata till färdiga analysunderlag.
Utveckla och vidareutveckla datalösningar i Microsoft Fabric  
Bygga och optimera datapipelines, Lakehouses och Dataflow Gen2  
Integrera olika datakällor och utveckla effektiva dataflöden  
Arbeta med Spark, SQL, DAX, notebooks och ETL-flöden  
Utveckla end-to-end-lösningar från datainsamling till analys och rapportering  
Delta i arkitektur- och designbeslut för dataplattformar  
Samarbeta med BI-utvecklare, analytiker och lösningsarkitekter

Vi söker dig som
Minst tre års erfarenhet av Data engineering eller utveckling av dataplattformar
Avancerad kunskap inom Microsoft Azure Data Platform, inklusive Databricks (PySpark) och ADLS
God förståelse för Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics och Power BI
Starka utvecklingsfärdigheter inom SQL och Python
Erfarenhet av att utveckla enterprise ETL/ELT-pipelines samt datamodellering
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, Git, DevOps samt Infrastructure as Code
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har
Certifieringar såsom DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), Azure Data Engineer eller Power BI Analyst
Erfarenhet av ERP-integrationer, till exempel Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O eller SAP S/4HANA
Kunskap inom strömmande teknologier och händelsestyrda arkitekturer
Erfarenhet av Docker, Kubernetes eller molnbaserade applikationsarkitekturer

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:
Hjälpsam
Målmedveten
Ansvarstagande
Intellektuellt nyfiken

Vår rekryteringsprocess
Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.
Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

ads.headline: Data Center Facilities Technician, Mechanical
ads.description_text:
Minimum qualifications:
Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of Mechanical/HVAC experience in an industrial or commercial environment.
Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.
Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.



Preferred qualifications:
5 years of experience in maintenance of mechanical/cooling distribution systems or construction/technical environment or a related field.
Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
Knowledge of mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Chillers, Air handling units, pumps and CRAC/CRAH units).
Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

About the job
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).


As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.
As a Mechanical Technician, you'll ensure 24/7 reliability of our physical infrastructure. Your core duties involve operating, monitoring, and supporting mechanical systems critical to data center performance, including: water pumps and treatment systems, chillers, HVAC and advanced control and monitoring systems. You'll regularly inspect, maintain, and repair these systems. Google commits to your professional growth, offering access to certifications and limitless opportunities to realize your full potential in this rapidly evolving field.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.


Sweden: kr680000 - kr695000 (SEK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits


Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities
Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems such as piping and mechanical system components.
Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.
Manage the uptime and maintenance of water pumps and treatment systems, HVAC and control and monitoring systems.
Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.
Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new mechanical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

ads.headline: Data Engineer
ads.description_text:
Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA home furnishing offer and make it more accessible for the many people. You will be part of IKEA Supply and the Supply Chain Development organisation. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost. 
Is This Role for Me?
Do you share IKEA’s values?
Do you have at least 5 years' experience as a Data Engineer or equivalent?
Are you Databricks or Fabric certified?
Do you have deep operational knowledge of Python, SQL and PySpark?

If your answer is yes to at least three of the four statements above, then come and join us at IKEA!
Job Description
Supply Data & Analytics has the assignment to create value and enable business growth by bringing data from across IKEA together to gather actionable insights. Data & Analytics is passionate about making data, analytics and insights easily findable and explainable for the many to enable better and faster decision-making.
We work closely with our business stakeholders and form product teams that deliver cutting edge data driven solutions for our coworkers.
We work in a modern multi cloud-based environment, and you will be a part of the engineering team continuously developing and operating data products and analytical capabilities. You will be regularly involved in workshops with coworkers to harness modern data infrastructure efficiently and provide long term solutions.
Supporting a complex organisation to realise the benefits that modern data engineering can bring is at the heart of the role.
As a Data Engineer at IKEA, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining our data infrastructure to support business needs, and decision-making processes.
Your responsibilities will include:
Design, develop, and maintain data models (including dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, and Medallion architecture) to support business needs of analytics and self-service reporting across Core Business Supply.
Design, implement, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate diverse internal and external data sources (databases, APIs, real-time streams) into IKEAs data platforms.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, data product leaders, and data scientists to translate complex supply chain and business requirements into scalable, performant, and well-governed data models and solutions.
Establish, promote, and enforce data engineering best practices, including data modelling standards, data quality, version control, testing, monitoring, documentation, and metadata management.
Optimise data models and pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency across batch and real-time processing.
Ensure data is stored, processed, and accessed securely, with full adherence to data governance, privacy, and compliance standards.
Contribute to the development and adoption of reusable frameworks, components, and semantic layers that accelerate data product delivery and increase consistency across the organisation.
Stay current with emerging data engineering technologies and practices, applying them where they create clear business value.
Promote a culture of data sharing, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement while guiding and developing less experienced coworkers through mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

In this role you will report to our Data Engineering Manager within Data & Technology at IKEA Supply.
The role is office based, with flexibility to work from home where required.
Qualifications
We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people & data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question, and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.
We believe that our new colleague in Data Engineering should have at least 5 years' experience in designing, building, implementing and operating data pipelines that collect, manage, and convert raw data into usable information, with a high industry standard as well as excellent knowledge of SQL, Python and PySpark.
In addition, excellent working knowledge of Databricks, with Associate Data Engineer or Professional Data Engineer certification is crucial. It would also be beneficial to have knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, ideally with DP-600 or DP-700 certification.
The ideal applicant has good communication and collaboration skills and will be a team player who takes ownership, builds cross-functional relationships with coworkers, and loves sharing knowledge. You are a curious problem solver who wants to keep learning in a dynamic global environment. The role is office based so meeting face to face and working collaboratively to solve problems should be something you enjoy.
The IKEA culture and values are crucial for our business and day to day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA here.
If you are passionate about data engineering, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want to contribute to the success of a global furniture retailer, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us as we continue to innovate and shape the future of our industry.
Additional information
We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process earlier than stated if we find the right candidate. This position will be based in Älmhult, Sweden. We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 22 Oct. 2026.
For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Håkan Almblad, Data Engineering Manager at hakan.almblad@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson at katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.

ads.headline: Head of Data & Analytics (vikariat)
ads.description_text:
Välkommen till vår värld! 👑 Vår vision är en värld som mår bra, och du kan hjälpa oss att göra den visionen verklig. Vi tror att meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter, starka teamrelationer och en generös dos skratt skapar en arbetsmiljö som inspirerar och stärker oss och alla våra kunder. Med fokus på både här och nu, samt på framtiden - bidrar vi tillsammans till en värld som mår bra! 🌍🧡🚀 

Nu söker vi en Head of Data & Analytics som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla och stärka Kronans Apoteks data- och analysförmåga. Detta är ett vikariat med start i november/december som pågår fram till oktober 2027. 

I rollen leder du ett kompetent team bestående av fem specialister inom Business Intelligence och Master Data. Du ansvarar för att säkerställa hög datakvalitet, effektiv informationshantering och ett tydligt informationsägarskap, samtidigt som du driver utvecklingen av moderna och skalbara lösningar inom BI, Analytics och AI.

Som Head of Data & Analytics har du en nyckelroll i verksamheten och samarbetar nära både affärsfunktioner, IT och externa partners för att skapa förutsättningar för datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktigt affärsvärde.

Exempel på dina arbetsuppgifter:

Ta fram och utveckla strategi, målbild och roadmap för Data & Analytics i linje med företagets affärsstrategi.

Etablera och vidareutveckla Data Governance samt säkerställa effektiv hantering av masterdata, metadata och andra affärskritiska informationsobjekt.

Leda utvecklingen inom Business Intelligence, Analytics och AI samt säkerställa att lösningarna möter verksamhetens behov.

Prioritera, följa upp och säkerställa affärsnyttan av initiativ och investeringar inom Data & Analytics.

Driva organisationens datadrivna arbetssätt genom förändringsledning, kommunikation och kompetensutveckling.

Säkerställa att data och analyser är tillgängliga, tillförlitliga och används som stöd för verksamhetens beslut.

Bygga starka samarbeten med verksamheten, IT, arkitektur, informationssäkerhet och externa partners.

Leda, coacha och utveckla teamet samt ansvara för budget, resursplanering och leverantörsstyrning


Du rapporterar till vår CFO, George Raheb, och välkomnas till vårt fina kontor i Stadshagen, Kungsholmen där vi sitter minst tre dagar i veckan.

Detta är ett vikariat vilket ställer krav på att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i verksamheten, skapa förtroende hos dina intressenter och ta ansvar för pågående initiativ från dag ett. Vi söker därför en erfaren ledare med gedigen kompetens inom Data & Analytics som är van att navigera i komplexa organisationer och omsätta strategi till resultat.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Flerårig erfarenhet av ledande roller inom Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Governance, Master Data Management eller närliggande områden.

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av personalansvar och att leda och utveckla team.

Erfarenhet av att etablera eller utveckla styrning, processer och arbetssätt för data, information och analys.

Erfarenhet av att driva strategiska och tvärfunktionella initiativ i större organisationer.

Erfarenhet av förändringsledning, budgetansvar och leverantörsstyrning.

God förståelse för informationshantering, dataplattformar, Business Intelligence, Analytics och AI.

Flytande i både svenska och engelska är ett krav.


Din ansökanI din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV eller din LinkedInprofil. Personligt brev? Det kan du skippa! Vi är intresserade av din kompetens, lära känna dig gör vi vid en eventuell intervju. I slutet av rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi en bakgrundskontroll på samtliga personer vi vill anställa, oavsett roll eller funktion. Då vi enbart tillämpar detta på slutkandidat informerar vi mer om det längre fram.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi bryr oss mer - och det är även något vi delar med våra fackliga parter och tillsammans arbetar vi för en värld som mår bra. För att komma i kontakt med våra fackliga representanter kan du maila Stephanie Nielsen på Unionen via stephanie.nielsen@kronansapotek.se eller Aisha Karimi på Sveriges Farmaceuter via af.kronan@sverigesfarmaceuter.se. Vill du fördjupa dig i vårt kollektivavtal? Du hittar hela avtalet här!

Så vilken väg vill du ta för att upptäcka din fulla potential? Leda, bredda eller djupa – valet är ditt!

Vi tror på att varje medarbetare har sin egen unika resa att göra, och vi är här för att stötta dig på den resan. Genom Må-bra samtal och vår kompetenstidsplan skräddarsyr vi en utvecklingsväg som passar just dig. Kanske vill du bli apotekets stjärna i kundservice, eller kanske lockar det dig att dyka djupare in i vår digitala värld? Möjligheterna är oändliga! 🚀

ads.headline: Data Scientist - Commercial
ads.description_text:
We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about leveraging data to drive commercial success in the gaming industry. In this role, you’ll focus on using analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimise game monetization strategies, support business development initiatives, and build scalable commercial tooling. You’ll partner with game designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to unlock data-driven insights that fuel our business growth and maximize player engagement.
Example of responsibilities 

Analyse game performance metrics and player data to identify business opportunities.


Provide insights and recommendations to optimise in-game economies, pricing models, and player engagement initiatives.


Collaborate with business development and product teams to develop data-driven monetization strategies.


Design, build, and maintain commercial tooling to empower commercial teams.


Build dashboards and reports to track business performance and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.


Utilize AI-assisted coding workflows to accelerate development.


We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind


Strong background in SQL


Experience in working with ETLs and data pipelines


Proficiency in Python for data modelling, analysis over large datasets, and script/tool building


Experience building tooling or interactive dashboards


Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools


Ability to communicate insights and strategies to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Experience or interest in games


Professional English communication skills. 


This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden.
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

ads.headline: HR Systems & Data Analytics Specialist
ads.description_text:
HR Systems & Data Analytics Specialist
We are looking for an analytical and solution-oriented HR Systems & Data Analytics Specialist for an exciting consulting assignment within a large international organization in the automotive industry.
In this role, you will support the development, operation and continuous improvement of HR systems, data management and reporting solutions. You will work closely with HR stakeholders to transform business requirements into effective, reliable and user-friendly solutions.
💼 About the Assignment
You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality HR data, developing reporting solutions and improving HR processes and systems. The assignment combines data analytics, business analysis, system support and continuous improvement in an international environment.
🔍 Key Responsibilities

Manage and validate HR data to ensure accuracy, consistency and transparency
Develop, maintain and improve HR reports and dashboards based on business requirements.
Translate HR business needs into functional system and reporting solutions.
Support system testing, releases and enhancements of HR applications.
Identify opportunities for process standardization, simplification and automation.
Provide functional support, documentation and guidance to HR users.
Collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting efficiency and system functionality.
✅ Requirements
To succeed in this role, you should have:
A university degree or equivalent education in Business Administration, HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, IT or a related field.
Experience or solid knowledge of Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Governance, HR IT or Enterprise Reporting.
Experience working with SAP-based HR applications and analytics solutions, such as SuccessFactors, Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) or equivalent systems.
Good proficiency in SQL and Excel.
Knowledge of data modelling, data quality and business analysis.
Experience working with enterprise applications and data, preferably within an HR environment.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
⭐ Nice to Have

Additional education or training in Data Analytics, BI, Data Governance, HR IT or Enterprise Reporting
Experience with Power BI.
Understanding of SAP HR data models and enterprise integrations
Knowledge of Python.
Experience with automation tools such as Power Automate, scripting or AI-assisted reporting.
Knowledge of Swedish, German or Portuguese.
🤝 Personal Qualities
We are looking for someone who is analytical, structured and proactive, with a strong ability to translate complex information into practical solutions.
You enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, communicating clearly and supporting users. You are curious, service-minded and motivated by improving processes, systems and ways of working.
📍 Location: Södertälje, Sweden 
📅 Assignment Period: Immediate start – April 30, 2027, with the possibility of extension 
🏢 Work Model: Hybrid, 2–3 days on-site per week
Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

ads.headline: Data Engineer
ads.description_text:
Hej Senior Data Engineer! 
Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions? 
With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Data Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before. 
We’re looking for senior data engineers who want to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. 
As part of the Data & Analytics team in Core Business Range, your new job will contribute to develop and deploy data products, strengthening the common ways of working. You will work closely with teams across the Inter IKEA group and with our partners. You are passionate about the digital transformation and see process and solution development as a key to make life easier for the many people and make a clear footprint in line with the IKEA direction. 
On a typical day as a senior data engineer, you will: 
Transform data into an analyzable format (ETL/ELT) to deliver business benefits. 
Develop and maintain infrastructures for data sourcing, processing, and sharing. 
Optimize, test, and implement tools to enhance data quality and monitor drift and decay. 
Manage data integration, processing, and modeling. 
Provide APIs for standardized data sharing and access. 
Translate business data needs into technical solutions and architectures. 
Ensure compliance with security, legal, and delivery standards. 
Support and coach teams in data-driven development. 
Document and share knowledge on data infrastructure within IKEA. 
Apply best practices in CI/CD and maintain cost-effective solutions. 

 


What we’d like you to bring to the table 
The role as Senior Data Engineer requires you to have:
Expertise in PySpark, Python and SQL: essential for developing efficient data pipelines and handling large-scale data processing. 
Experience in levering AI assistants like github copilot and databricks genie code.  
You have solid knowledge of industry-standard software development languages and a deep understanding of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures. 
You are a proactive team player who takes ownership, builds cross-functional relationships with senior peers, and enjoys mentoring junior colleagues. 
You are a curious, world-class problem solver passionate about continuous learning and innovation. 
At least five years of experience in data engineering. 
You embody IKEA’s values in both thought and action. Explore what it means to work at IKEA here: https://en-global-jobs.about.ikea.com/lifeatikea 

 


Be yourself, a Data Engineer, and more! 
Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. 
Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. 
 


We welcome your application 
Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 25th of October. This is a permanent position based in Malmö, with occasional travel to Älmhult as needed to meet business requirements. For any questions about the recruitment process, you can directly connect with vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.  
The contract title for this position is Data Engineer.
At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs. 
If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know. 
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.
